rounds.text: The market is heavily discounting a business whose fundamental growth and cash generation significantly outpace its valuation multiples [E54]. Shares trade at a modest P/E of 15.7 [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of just 1.17x [E2], presenting a deep discount compared to broader sector benchmarks [E6, E7]. This disconnect occurs despite robust compounding, evidenced by a 5-year sales growth of 23% and a 5-year profit growth of 30% [E15, E19], alongside a trailing twelve-month profit jump of 24% [E21]. Furthermore, operations are exceptionally cash-generative, producing Rs 83 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 67 Cr in free cash flow for March 2026, backed by a stellar 2.59x cash conversion rate where profits are fully supported by actual cash [E34, E35, E36]. The company operates with a pristine balance sheet, carrying a minimal debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09x and working capital requirements that have efficiently compressed from 57.6 days to 38.6 days [E38, E59]. Conceded: the stock is severely lagging the broader market with a relative-strength rating of 0, a negative Sharpe ratio, and a multi-year share price decline that reflects weak sentiment and depressed medium-term momentum [E22, E24, E25, E50, E53, E71].
